leads.arxiv: 2607.21447 (arXiv API: v1 2026-07-23; title: RUMBA: Russian User Memory Benchmark)

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A Russian (plus aligned English subset) long-term conversational memory benchmark: 85 dialogues of 12-85 timestamped sessions each and 1,543 QA pairs. Its taxonomy includes UpdatingInfo, DeleteInfo, temporal reasoning and multi-session questions.
